notes.title: iB Cricket Key Updates 2024!!
notes.content:
[h2]Updates Summary:[/h2]
We have enhanced various systems, including fielding, bowling, field settings, pitch parameters, and commentary. We've upgraded the graphics quality, providing a more immersive experience. Significant updates have been made to the look and feel of the game with new stadiums, a new dressing room, new bat skins, new jerseys, and revamped the home screen UX for a more intuitive navigation experience. We've also added detailed live match stats in the game to help you analyze and refine your gameplay.

We've completely revamped the onboarding experience for new users and added an FAQ section that contains insights and solutions for a smooth, enjoyable gaming experience.

For more details on all the enhancements, updates and changes, please refer to the detailed notes.

[h2]Detailed Notes:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/5d8663204d1d801202c9d1d79c7c122e6d5247bd.png[/img]
[h3]Bowling🤾‍♂️[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve enhanced the bowling logic to bring it closer to real-world cricket
[*] Bowlers maintain consistent strength in Insane and Ultra-insane modes
[*] Significantly enhanced the effectiveness of swing, seam, cutters, and spin deliveries.
[*] Refined the speed and angle of spin for spin bowlers and fine-tuned the speed for cutters.
[*] Dynamic variations in bowling with enhanced line and length adjustments that adapt to field settings, batsmen's scoring areas etc providing a more strategic gameplay
[*] Improved the distribution algorithm of right-arm and left-arm bowlers selected and actively bowling throughout matches
[*] Improved Intelligent field placements based on the batsmen’s scoring regions throughout the match
[*] Improved AI strategies for maintaining fair gameplay
[*] The issue of consecutive wides has been resolved
[/list]
[h3]Fielding🏃[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fielding has been made more realistic
[*] Enhanced fielder selection logic to ensure more relevant fielders are chosen, based on the ball's hit direction and speed
[*] Improved fielding accuracy and game realism
[*] Significant improvement has been made in how fielders collect the ball
[*] Fielders will position themselves more accurately to collect the ball in line with its trajectory
[*] Fine-tuned running speeds for fielders, ensuring they reach the ball with optimal timing
[*] Bowlers now have improved reaction times when balls are hit towards them
[*] Fielders now immediately react when the ball hits the helmet in helmet view, preventing unnecessary byes
[/list]
[h3]Pitches:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the realism in the behavior of swing, seam, cutters, spin, and bounciness across Green, Bouncy, Dry, and Normal pitches
[*] Swing, seam, cutters, and spin now vary based on ball newness in Insane and Ultra-Insane modes, adding depth to gameplay strategy
[*] Bounce on dry pitches is updated to match real-world conditions
[/list]
[h3]Commentary🎙️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the commentary with additional phrases to enhance your game experience.
[*] Voice quality for commentary has been upgraded
[*] Made corrections to contextual inaccuracies in certain commentary phrases
[/list]
[h3]Home Screen UX/UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've revamped the home screen UX and UI for more intuitive navigation by categorizing the game modes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/331def8c1faa3d1fe9c97a7c0ed4bd11deffef58.png[/img]
[h3]New Stadiums🏟️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Five new world-class stadiums and one practice stadium are now available for purchase in the shop
[/list]
[h3]Dressing Room[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Dressing Room with a fresh look and feel
[/list]
[h3]New Bat Skins:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Bat skins with enhanced wood textures for a more authentic cricketing experience
[/list]
[h3]New Stumps:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've introduced illuminated stumps that light up dynamically whenever the ball makes contact with them enhancing immersion and making every wicket feel even more impactful
[/list]
[h3]Updated Jerseys👕[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated jersey designs, offering a fresh look for both International and Indian city teams
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/ab72d289bf876c3c3ad0dbd6aee6f7d47f5d41d5.png[/img]
[h3]In-Game VR Match Stats🏏[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the following live detailed match stats at the end of each delivery to help you analyze and refine your gameplay.
[*] Ball Trace of Deliveries: Track the ball deliveries for each over.
[*] Pitch Map of Deliveries: Access the pitch map for the complete innings so far, as well as for the current over.
[*] 3D Wagon Wheel (Beta): Visualize the last 30 balls faced with our new 3D wagon wheel feature.
[*] Worm Graph & Manhattan Graph: Analyze your innings with the comprehensive Worm graph and Manhattan graph.
[*] Match Summary: Get a complete summary of the match, including detailed scorecard of batsmen and bowlers
[/list]
[h3]My Matches:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Access the pending matches of the following match types from your VR game in a single place
[*] Knockout matches from Season Tournament
[*] Dual-player leagues with 10-over and 50-over matches
[/list]
[h3]In-Game FAQs🤔[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now access FAQs directly in the VR game for instant help. Get answers and support without leaving the game!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/b6288b46396b0a702464dd1d3e04be77dfd91a6e.png[/img]
[h3]New User Flow:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have revamped the onboarding process, aimed at ensuring a smoother and quicker learning curve for the new users. The updated steps dynamically adapt to the user's gameplay making the introduction more intuitive and seamless.
[/list]
[h3]Custom Tournaments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Organizers can now configure the end date of tournaments to better suit their scheduling needs.
[*] Introducing Ultra-Insane bowling difficulty option for those seeking the ultimate challenge.
[*] Invitation message now includes comprehensive match configuration details, ensuring all participants are fully informed.
[*] Addressed the net run-rate calculation issue
[*] Corrected the logic of fixture creation for knockout matches
[/list]
[h3]Team Chasing Challenge🎯[/h3]
[list]
[*] Our targeting system now intelligently adapts based on your progress, ensuring a more personalized gameplay experience.
[/list]
[h3]Season Tournaments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] View schedules for 250, 500, and 1000 tournaments directly from the tournaments home screen, ensuring you never miss a match.
[/list]

notes.title: Many Exciting Features
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]

[h3]1. CO-OP[/h3]
    [olist]
    [*] Play matches together with a friend in Co-Op mode.
    [*] There are two options to choose from - Campaigns or Quick Start
    [*] Tournaments will be released Soon next week
    [*] Option to mute mic
    [/olist]
[h3]2. 360 Degree Tournament[/h3]
    [olist]
    [*] In the 360 Degree Tournament, you can bat all around the stadium and make runs in every region
    [*] Runs above the region limit don’t count!
    [/olist]
[h3]3. Practice[/h3]
    [olist]
    [*] You can choose line and length and a specific special ball
    [*] Customize Field positions
    [*] Customize Pitch options
    [*] Batsman Type selection
    [/olist]
[h3]4. Custom Tournaments[/h3]
    [olist]
    [*] Challenge your friends with PvP option
    [*] Toss decides who will bat first
    [*] New UX/UI in pool matches you can play matches whenever you want
    [*] Pause and resume enabled for custom tournament
    [*] Wagon Wheel added to end match UI
    [/olist]
[h3]5. PvP[/h3]
    [olist]
    [*] Now you can bowl to opponent with VR Bowling
    [*] Option to mute mic
    [/olist]
6. Super Runs and Bat Shield added in Tutorial Flow

7. With single controller, you can navigate through entire game

[h3]8. Changes in profile.ib.cricket[/h3]
    [olist]
    [*] Manhattan Graph and Worm Graph of your opponents and you
    [*] Starts in time or ends in time added in the match cards
    [*] Added Bowler name in the ball by ball match details screen
    [*] Rounds in a tournament colliding with round ends in time (edited)
    [/olist]


[h2][b]Enhancements[/b][/h2]

1. Displaying worm graph for dual player matches
2. In-Game Optimizations
3. Big stadiums can now get more than 3 runs based on time required for a fielder to reach
4. The maximum render scale value has been increased to 1.4
5. Updating of fieldsets is currently based on successive boundaries hit and also successive 3’s
6. Making bottom most boundary ads in black color when bowler starts runup
    [list]
    [*] The New Zealand Jersey color has been changed.
    [/list]


[h2][b]Bugs Fixed[/b][/h2]

1. Keeper giving more byes
2. Slow balls delivery in continuation match in Insane mode
3. Consecutive wides (more than 3-4 at a stretch)
4. UI screens overlapping in settings
5. When bat-shield size is given for user to check, sometimes the shield is getting stuck in air

Stay tuned for more updates!

Join us on Discord - https://discord.gg/JCbDw82
Check out your profile at https://profile.ib.cricket/profile

    [*]Around the wicket bowling in all modes
        [list]
             [*]Right arm fast can not come around wicket to Right-hand batsman. Vice versa for left hand.
             [*]Right arm off spin can come around wicket to Right-hand batsman.
        [/list]
    [*]Option to choose fielding difficulty level in PvP - Novice, Amateur, Semi-Pro, Pro, Super Fielders
    [*]In PVP, Players can choose the number of Special Balls before start of the innings (2, 3, 4)
    [*]Special balls animations are added 
    [*]Very easy mode in Quick Start
    [*]Now users have an option to play with Vive tracker
[/olist]
[h2]Enhancements[/h2]

    [*]In Leagues, spinners for each Pitch has been reduced

             [*]Green Pitch - 0 spinners. So for bowling presets everyone is given 9 bowlers 1 extra right arm medium fast.
             [*]Normal Pitch, Bouncy Pitch - 1 spinner
             [*]Dry Pitch - 2 spinners both the spinners same level
         [/list]
    [*]Default field sets tab is given for all the players. You can use them while setting PVP or bowling presets
    [*]Max Height Of Batsman in each delivery is included to improve the wide calls.
    [*]The same height profile will be used to identify the number of players playing in an account. If more than 5 batsman profiles are detected in an account for more than 4 days in a month the account will be put on hold and the players need to contact support.
    [*]Offside wide is made very strict i.e on the line will be called a wide.
    [*]Helper UI text at controller/bat selection section in Quest
    [*]Optimized the message flow for PVP matches
    [*]Changes are done to worm graph for 50 over league matches
    [*]When a wide ball is bowled in leagues, picking the appropriate ball for the next delivery is added so wides will be reduced.
    [*]In replay, setting the size of batsman character based on his height
    [*]Max edge deflection has been updated to 60
    [*]Scoreboards will be displayed on either side of wickets.
    [*]Introducing unbought stadiums(1-6) in challenges.
    [*]Gems for achieving milestones 50,100,150 etc... Only with 0% Bat Shield, Hard and insane level bowling.
    [*]Local PvP
        [list]
             [*]User fielding presets are available
             [*]Decreased special balls per over
             [*]Decreased size of special balls images so that more special balls are visible per screen
         [/list]
    [*]PvP
        [list]
             [*]Ball trace off | on the option made available for all modes before starting of a match not just for insane.
             [*]Trackpad to adjust the position of the ball within a region.
             [*]Able to set close fielders in a fieldset with zoom-in option
         [/list]
    [*]Now you can select 0, 10, 30, 50, 70, 100 Bat-shield options in QuickStart with ease
    [*]Strong hand selection for Local PvP for both the innings
    [*]Displaying Leaderboard at end of the match for single-player league matches
    [*]Confirmation when switching between leagues
    [*]Bat Grip adjustment allowed size increased to support Valve Index controllers
    [*]In PvP, Bowlers can view the scorecard in front, instead of looking back.
    [*]Removing Low bounce from all the pitches except Dry pitch
    [*]Removing High bounce from Dry Pitch
    [*]You can turn off after impact ball trial from Settings 
[/olist]

Join us on Discord - https://discord.gg/JCbDw82

notes.title: Public Beta for one of the most awaited features, 'Local PvP' is now available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/11ccd843c65cc298d7dfbbd305f4ce251661e024.jpg[/img]

In this beta-version, you get to bowl to your friends & challenge him in one-on-one match. As it is a "Local PvP", you and your friend need to play on the same system (PC / Laptop). One player bowls from the controls given on the monitor and the other bats in VR.

To start Local PvP in beta branch, all you need to do is, go to the dressing room and press F7 in the keyboard. To close the Local PvP screen in the dressing room, press F8 in the keyboard.


[h1][b]Local PvP[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/5023f39b68429a560470d4409413f9f79713a5f1.png[/img]

Enter your names, select the size of the bat-shield, stadium, environment, and overs of your choice, and start the match.


[h3][b]Choose the Bowling Style[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/389110d87099b51ad1cbe73e0b7455a66fa321d9.png[/img]

You can select from any of the given bowlers. You will be given 15 seconds to choose a bowler.


[h3][b]Strategize the Bowling & Fielding[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/502ebff17405b7cde0f6064ab2232d6c1a9bfd86.png[/img]

To make it more exciting, we have introduced the concept of Efforts(e) in bowling. For the line & length you select to bowl, you need to spend some efforts. If you wanted to bowl a special-ball, you need to spend some efforts. These efforts will reset at the start of each over. So with the available efforts, you need to choose wisely, strategize, and bowl. Also, you can choose from the predefined fieldsets to strategize the fielding.

You will be given 15 seconds for each delivery to choose from the different options available and bowl.

We will be glad to hear your feedback and suggestions. Based on the feedback and suggestions received, we will release the "Online PvP" soon. 

Check-out how to switch to Beta Branch on Steam: https://discordapp.com/channels/762605669332287508/788994124862193694/789091491087122452

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/73285967a2cba214b6c16943a3411728e88c3e6d.png[/img]

Hello Gamers,
To take the excitement further, we're coming up with Pilot Season Tournament starting from 3rd Dec at 7:00 AM (GMT).

[b]It comprises of 12 iBC 250 Tournaments, 4 iBC 500 Tournaments & 1 iBC 1000 Tournament.[/b]
[list]
[*] iBC 250 Tournaments start from Dec 3rd
[*] iBC 500 Tournaments start from Dec 7th
[*] iBC 1000 Tournament starts on Dec 25th
[/list]
[b]INTRODUCING iBC RATINGS[/b]
iBC Rating determines your position in the Tournaments. Your iBC Rating shows your skill, so you get recognized for your competitive spirit with love and fame. 

There are 6 Rounds in each of the iBC 250, iBC 500 & iBC 1000 Tournaments. Round 1 is Leaderboard. Top 32 people in Round-1 (Leaderboard) will proceed to Round 2. From Round 2 it's all knockouts leading to the Finals.

Round-2(Top 32 from leaderboard) -> Round3(16) -> Quater Finals(8) -> Semi Finals(4) -> Finals(2)

You get IBC Ratings based on number of rounds you cleared in the tournament.

[b]The size of bat-shield varies among the iBC 250, iBC 500 and iBC 1000 tournaments. With iBC 1000 having smallest bat-shield size when compared to that of iBC 500 and iBC 250 tournaments.[/b]
[list]
[*] You will get 250 iBC Ratings upon winning iBC 250 Tournament.
[*] You will get 500 iBC Ratings upon winning iBC 500 Tournament.
[*] You will get 1000 iBC Ratings upon winning iBC 1000 Tournament.
[/list]
[b]Your iBC Rating for the entire Pilot Season Tournament is cumulative of best 4 Ratings from iBC 250 tournaments, best 1 Rating from iBC 500 tournaments, and your rating from iBC 1000 tournament.[/b]

Also, we've made the following enhancement in this update.

[*] Now, you get to play with either of the controllers on the supported headsets (Vive, Vive-Pro, Valve Index, Rift S, Quest with link cable). You just need to press the trigger button on the controller inorder to use it as the bat in the game.
